name: thinkred-monorepo
description: ThinkRED monorepo containing frontend React app and Google Apps Script backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.release:frontend: npm run version:patch:frontend && npm run deploy:frontend && npm run tag:frontend
scripts.release:backend: npm run version:patch:backend && npm run deploy:backend && npm run tag:backend
scripts.release:minor:frontend: npm run version:minor:frontend && npm run deploy:frontend && npm run tag:frontend
scripts.release:minor:backend: npm run version:minor:backend && npm run deploy:backend && npm run tag:backend
scripts.release:major:frontend: npm run version:major:frontend && npm run deploy:frontend && npm run tag:frontend
scripts.release:major:backend: npm run version:major:backend && npm run deploy:backend && npm run tag:backend

author: ThinkRED Tech
